Mientras tanto, Rebeca planea informarle a Manuela que no puede tener hijos y Elizabeth lidia con la culpa por la ruptura de la pareja. Ricardo queda devastado al perder a Manuela, mientras otros personajes como Gustavo y René enfrentan sus propios dramas familiares y procesos de recuperación.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se topa con Blanca en la calle y corre tras ella llamando "mamá", pero la amnésica no la reconoce y huye. Amalia echa a Rosa de su casa al verla llegar a hablar con Alejandro. Junior alcanza a Rosa y le miente diciendo que Alejandro ya estaba cansado de ella. Erasto confiesa a Arminda su decisión de hacer desaparecer a José Luis para silenciar sus sospechas sobre Blanca. Isaías decide formalizar su negocio de dólares con Eustoquio. Amalia presiona a Alejandro para que vuelva con Rosalía, la mujer que conviene a su posición social.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Robert y Andreína celebran su contratación artística. Leticia aconseja a Consuelo pedir ayuda a Erasto para hallar a su hija; ella accede. Blanca empieza a recordar fragmentos en su refugio con los mendigos. Arminda planea junto a Eustoquio enloquecer a Erasto. Isaías descubre que Natalia, amante de Erasto, vive en la misma residencia que Rosa. Junior va a Rosa para informarle que Alejandro y Rosalía regresaron. Erasto, sorprendido por la visita de Consuelo, escucha su petición y prepara nuevas intrigas para acercarse a la hija perdida.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: En plena firma de sociedad, Isaías irrumpe insultando a Adolfo y le grita a Consuelo que todo terminó. Maricela golpea a una enfermera y huye de la clínica. Maricela e Isaías se encuentran y beben juntos, intercambiando confidencias. Eustoquio atrapa a Blanca en la calle e intenta matarla, pero Rosa los descubre y comienza a gritar pidiendo auxilio. José Luis confronta directamente a Consuelo sobre su relación con Adolfo. Junior, mientras tanto, manipula a Rosa para llevarla al liceo, insistiendo en su conquista.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: El pasajero misterioso que venía en el avión con Leonardo resulta ser Rebeca Villegas la supuestamente esposa muerta de Leonardo. Llegan a la empresa y Leonardo trata de preparar a todos para avisarles. Cuando los hijos de Leonardo y Rebeca están en la empresa esta se presenta y dice que recordaba sus caras pero en realidad que había perdido la memoria durante los años que pasaron. Leonardo le pide a Irene que lo espere pero Irene se siente frustrada al ver que Leonardo no toma cartas en el asunto. El médico que le podía arruinar los planes a Adolfo es adrede arrollado por un auto conducido por gente que estaba al servicio de este.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Pasaron cinco años desde que Sol y Madroño se fueron. Al regresar, Sol descubre que no Solo es ella la que ha cambiado. Aída se ha vuelto alcohólica a causa de la separación de su hija y del infeliz matrimonio que lleva con Alejandro, que sigue pensando en Sol. Eloy está por salir de la cárcel, donde se ha estado acostando con una prostituta que ahora está enamorada de él. Cuando Sol va a visitarlo, descubre que esa mujer es la hija abandonada de Reina Monserrat.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri y Wilker comen sus helados y siguen hablando de sus cosas y al llegar a la casa de ella terminan despidiéndose con un beso. Atanasio muy emocionado agradece a Graciela que lo haya llamado e incluso que le haya llevado un regalo | mientras ella piensa que lo que tiene que hacer es decirle que la ama y que no se casará | le ofrece cenar pero ella decide marcharse y él le muestra el collarcito que le llevó como regalo y ella lo abraza | lo besa y se marcha llorando.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 223: Celos, mantas y responsabilidades inesperadas.
programme.desc: Dileidy y Luis Fernando duermen en la misma habitación pero separados por una manta. Eglee debe lidiar con la presencia de Gerson. Monchito se da cuenta de que Matilde tiene que cuidar de sus hijos. Rómulo se pone celoso de Santiago.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Con la reaparición con vida de Rebeca después de cinco años en los cuales se la daba por muerta, la tranquilidad en la casa y en la familia Ferrándiz se ve amenazada. La relación entre Leonardo e Irene, se pone muy tensa, ya que Leonardo no encuentra la forma de contarle a Rebeca sobre su actual relación sentimental con ella. Irene no se siente preparada para confesarle a Leonardo que está embarazada, su permanencia en la casa se ve totalmente amenazada por la llegada de Rebeca. Virginia le pide a María Lucía que vaya a la casa de los Ferrándiz para acompañar a su tía, Irene. Ésta va acompañada de Sandra y se cruza con Leo, al cual le recuerda que su relación está más que terminada.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol se presenta en medio del festejo de aniversario de un año de casados de Alejandro y Aída. Los lleva dentro de la casa a ambos junto a Reina y les explica que ha vuelto para quedarse en la casa, y les muestra el papel que confirma que ella es la dueña. Por una cuestión de piedad, Sol decide dejar que Alejandrito, Alejandro y Aída se queden a vivir allí, pero aun así decide echar a Reina, agregándole además que conoció a la hija que ella abandonó y que irá a vivir a la mansión.

programme.title: Kompromat: O Dossiê Russo
programme.desc: Baseado em fatos reais, o novo thriller de espionagem de Jérôme Salle narra a incrível história de um funcionário público francês que, sem querer, entra em conflito com uma das forças mais poderosas e perigosas da era moderna: o FSB russo. Gilles Lellouche interpreta Mathieu, um diplomata carismático e dedicado que aceita um posto em Irkutsk como diretor da Aliança Francesa na Sibéria. Ele espera que a mudança beneficie sua família e seu casamento em crise, mas logo sua organização de eventos culturais e apoio à expressão artística o colocam em rota de colisão com as autoridades locais. Acusado de um crime terrível, ele descobre que o FSB fabricou um caso contra ele. Preso, encarcerado e isolado, sem ajuda das autoridades francesas, parece não ter outra opção: tentar fugir.

programme.title: O Dono do Jogo

O duelo, que ocorreu em 1972, no auge da Guerra Fria, foi muito mais do que apenas uma série de partidas para conquistar um campeonato.

Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.title: A Árvore Da Vida
programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

They loathe each other when they meet for the first time, but are soon forced to work together to face unexpected circumstances when they are accused of a crime they have not committed. The BSF, CBI and mafia are all on their tails. This deadly escapade interrupted by personal clashes eventually creates a bond between Aftab and Jay, who must fight against all odds to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Captain's Log

Adam Hays travels to Alberta to hunt for giant bruins with Clay Charlton of Take-em Outfitters!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 10 is a wrap! Rush takes a moment to look back on some of his favorite moments from battling giant snook and feisty tarpon in Florida, to overnighting at Catalina Island, and chasing bull redfish in Louisiana. This season was all about getting out there with good friends, making new ones, and enjoying the sport we love. An unforgettable year filled with adventure, laughs, and epic days on the water.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.desc: If you've never been to Alaska, it is an absolute must-see. Alaska is amazingly unique. If you have been there before, you know what we are talking about. Last week Shea McIntee and the crew settled in at Alaskan Anglers Inn, headed out fishing, and hooked onto their personal best halibut. programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.desc: If you have never been to Alaska before, these next three episodes are an absolute must-see. The crew heads to Glacier Bay National Park, Alaska, to meet up with Alaskan Anglers Inn for an epic week of fishing. This fishing destination is unique in more ways than one. programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.sub-title: FishON | Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. The adventure doesn’t end there—a bonus portage into another lake offers a chance to explore uncharted waters. It’s a fitting conclusion to a season filled with the unexpected and unforgettable.
